# ECC for Copilot

These Copilot CLI agent profiles are adapted from [affaan-m/ECC](https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC), an MIT-licensed project. The upstream agent prompts are retained with their Claude-specific tool and model declarations removed; each profile is intended for use with Copilot CLI tools and this repository's `AGENTS.md`.

The Copilot-compatible ECC skills and Copilot Chat prompts are also included in `.github/skills/` and `.github/prompts/`. See `.github/ECC-INTEGRATION.md` for scope and known limitations.

In Copilot CLI, run `/agent` to browse and select an agent. The selected profile does not automatically grant tools or run other agents.

See `ECC-LICENSE.txt` for the upstream license.
